requirements.text: 1+ years of experience with a BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field.
Strong proficiency in C/Golang/Rust, and Python programming languages
knowledge of OS internals, particularly UNIX/Linux
Familiarity with x86 architecture, virtualization, storage, and network management
Good understanding of multi-threading, algorithms, and data structures on Linux
Strong debugging skills in Linux kernel mode

Are you passionate about open-source technologies and have a deep understanding of kernel-level systems? If so, joining our team at Nutanix as a Member of Technical Staff - AHV offers the exciting opportunity to contribute to the development of an enterprise-grade hypervisor, working with cutting-edge technologies and making a significant impact on the advancement of our software solution.
